items.label: Corollary 1
items.issue: The induction step in the proof writes \ell(x,\pi_E) = \ell(x,\pi_{E_1 \cup \dots \cup E_j} \circ \pi_{E_{j+1}}), implicitly assuming that the canonical registration order on E is compatible with ordering the connected components sequentially, or that non-adjacent skills commute in loss when interleaved with other skills.
items.fix: State explicitly in Assumption 4 (or in the execution rule) that non-adjacent skills commute, so that permuting the canonical order of E to group connected components E_1, ..., E_m sequentially does not change \ell(x,\pi_E).

review.overall: The mathematical formulation and all proofs in the theory section are rigorous, precise, and free of counterexamples, with all constants and inequalities verified. Only Corollary 1 has a minor implicit step regarding the ordering of skills across connected components relative to the canonical registration order.
